findings.description: The removed block normalized a path_url starting with "//" down to a single slash before it was passed to urllib3. With it gone, path_url like "//foo" goes to urlopen unchanged.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a request to http://host//foo, so path_url is "//foo". The title says path_url should preserve leading slashes, and that change belongs in models.py (PreparedRequest.path_url). This diff only deletes the adapter workaround and no models.py change is shown. The workaround existed because urllib3 would treat "//foo" as a network-path reference, which can mean parsing "foo" as the host. Without it, the wrong host or path may be requested, or the request may fail.
